Name: Dialogue Changes Full for 1.1
Author: KeionDryke
Description:
***This mod has not been updated since 1.1 Life has been too hectic and I've been out of the mod scene for a while cause of it. If you wish to update the files, feel free and send me a message and credit me for the original files.***

"WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. [url=http://www.stardewvalleymods.net/]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET[/url] STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE."

***NOW UPDATED FOR VERSION 1.1***


Finally no more worry about patches for all the different mods for the gender swapped bachelors. Here's the complete and full mod putting everything together.

I put this together to go along with Adarin's Girl mods which is some awesome artwork.

[size=4][u]Installation
[/u][/size]Unpack into the Content folder in your Stardew Valley directory.
Let it over write the other files.
Don't forget to back up the originals.

To uninstall, just put the originals back and let them over write.

If you find any errors, please let me know. Keep in mind certain things are hard coded into the game and can't be changed yet.

Thanks to Adarin for the great graphics mod he made which inspired me to create this mod to go along with it.
